input:
Labeled defect
- root cause: Response.__init__ reads self.raw.reason to initialize reason, but raw has no underlying response object yet at construction time, so the attribute access dereferences None.
- failure path: Any call that builds a Response, such as every adapter.send or a plain Response(), raises AttributeError ('NoneType' object has no attribute 'reason') before the object is populated, so no request can complete.

Reviewer finding
- description: Response.__init__ now reads self.raw.reason, but self.raw is None on a freshly constructed Response, and the adapter sets raw and reason only after construction. This raises AttributeError.
- rationale: Trigger: any call to Response(), e.g. in adapters.build_response or by users and tests. Mechanism: self.raw is initialized to None in __init__, so accessing .reason on None fails. Impact: constructing any Response crashes, breaking essentially all requests.
critique: Both describe Response.__init__ reading self.raw.reason while raw is None at construction. This raises AttributeError and breaks every Response creation and request. Same operation, same failure.
